culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Shinsuke Akiyama. He faked his own death using Inspector Takeda's lifeless body (whom he first strangled, then he decapitated) as a decoy, and was aiming to kill Inspectors Saegusa and Yamato too. His motive is that years ago, Inspector Yamato and his companions's mistakes led to a serial killer terrorizing Nagano before being shot dead, and one of his victims was Detective Akiyama's beloved middle school-aged sister, Tsuyako Aburakawa, who was his only relative. His chosen name Bishamonten was his selfperception as a punisher of evildoers.

motive.quote: In order to complete this inner circle, they were looking for new members; hence they also attempted to recruit Inspector Yamato, whose name as akin to Shingen's general Yamamoto Kansuke.

method.quote: He faked his own death using Inspector Takeda's lifeless body (whom he first strangled, then he decapitated) as a decoy, and was aiming to kill Inspectors Saegusa and Yamato too.

evidence.quote: In fact, as Conan, Inspectors Yamato and Morufushi have found out, the Takeda Squad formed the notorious Woodpecker Society; the "X" imprint left on the victims' bodies pointed to the letter X being the 24th letter of the Western alphabet, corresponding to Takeda Shingen's 24 Generals.

motive.zhHans: 为了完成这个核心圈子，他们在寻找新成员；因此他们也试图招募Yamato警部，其名字与Shingen的家臣Yamamoto Kansuke相近。Akiyama警探将武田分队列为剿灭目标的原因是，分队/协会的成员为中饱私囊，扣押并把没收的枪支卖给犯罪分子，而正是其中一支枪杀死了Tsuyako。Akiyama警探盯上Yamato警部，是因为正是他那有毒瘾的朋友开出了致命一枪。杀人未遂地点：被通缉强盗的藏身处；被害人：Kansuke Yamato；攻击方式：枪击；犯人：Shinsuke Akiyama。在他被抓住时，他朝他开了三枪，但他用防暴盾保护了自己。
motive.en: In order to complete this inner circle, they were looking for new members; hence they also attempted to recruit Inspector Yamato, whose name as akin to Shingen's general Yamamoto Kansuke. The reason why Detective Akiyama targeted the Takeda Squad for extermination was that the Squad/Society members seized and sold confiscated guns to criminal elements in order to line their pockets, and it was one of these guns which killed Tsuyako. Detective Akiyama targeted Inspector Yamato because it was his drug-addicted friend who fired the fatal shot. Attempted Murder Location: Place of the hideout of the wanted robber Victim: Kansuke Yamato Attack types: Shooting Culprit: Shinsuke Akiyama While he was caught, he fired three bullets at him, but he used a riot shield to protect himself.

method.zhHans: 他用Takeda警部毫无生气的尸体（他先将其勒死，随后斩首）作诱饵伪造自己的死亡，并且还打算杀死Saegusa警部和Yamato警部。杀人未遂地点：被通缉强盗的藏身处；被害人：Kansuke Yamato；攻击方式：枪击；犯人：Shinsuke Akiyama。在他被抓住时，他朝他开了三枪，但他用防暴盾保护了自己。他在与Yamato对峙时被捕，因为事实证明Kuroda早已对Akiyama起疑，而他下达的命令（把Yamato标记为最大嫌疑人）是假的，意在迷惑Akiyama并把他引出来。
method.en: He faked his own death using Inspector Takeda's lifeless body (whom he first strangled, then he decapitated) as a decoy, and was aiming to kill Inspectors Saegusa and Yamato too. Attempted Murder Location: Place of the hideout of the wanted robber Victim: Kansuke Yamato Attack types: Shooting Culprit: Shinsuke Akiyama While he was caught, he fired three bullets at him, but he used a riot shield to protect himself. He's arrested while confronting Yamato, as it turns out that Kuroda was already suspicious of Akiyama and the order he gave (to signal Yamato as the biggest suspect) was a fake one designed to throw off Akiyama and lure him out.

evidence.zhHans: 事实上，正如Conan、Yamato警部和Morufushi警部所查明的，武田分队组成了臭名昭著的啄木鸟会；留在被害人尸体上的「X」印记指向字母X是西方字母表的第24个字母，对应武田信玄的二十四将。
evidence.en: In fact, as Conan, Inspectors Yamato and Morufushi have found out, the Takeda Squad formed the notorious Woodpecker Society; the "X" imprint left on the victims' bodies pointed to the letter X being the 24th letter of the Western alphabet, corresponding to Takeda Shingen's 24 Generals.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Shinsuke Akiyama。他用Takeda警部毫无生气的尸体（他先将其勒死，随后斩首）作诱饵伪造自己的死亡，并且还打算杀死Saegusa警部和Yamato警部。他的动机是多年前Yamato警部及其同伴的过失导致一名连环杀手在长野作恶，最终被击毙，而该杀手的一名被害人是Akiyama警探深爱的、读初中的妹妹Tsuyako Aburakawa，她是他唯一的亲人。他选择的名字毗沙门天是他对自身作为恶人惩罚者的自我认知。意外杀人（过去）地点：未知
